# App Store Pre-Submission Readiness Checklist

Companion to `docs/app-store-listing.md`. This file covers the *technical*
side: Info.plist permissions, ATS, encryption declarations, build settings,
demo account seed, and what's likely to trip an Apple reviewer.

---

## 1 · Info.plist (auto-generated by Expo prebuild)

Expo SDK 55 + the plugins we ship merge into `Info.plist` at prebuild. Below
is what *should* end up in the final binary.

### Already set (from `app.json` and plugin configs)

| Key | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `CFBundleDisplayName` | `ShiftRest` | `expo.name` |
| `CFBundleIdentifier` | `com.gazetastreet.shiftrest` | `ios.bundleIdentifier` |
| `CFBundleVersion` | `1` | `ios.buildNumber` |
| `CFBundleShortVersionString` | `0.1.0` | `expo.version` |
| `UIRequiredDeviceCapabilities` | `armv7` | Expo default |
| `LSRequiresIPhoneOS` | `true` | Expo default |
| `UIRequiresFullScreen` | `false` | iPad split-view safe (we don't support iPad anyway) |
| `UISupportedInterfaceOrientations` | Portrait only | `expo.orientation = portrait` |
| `ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption` | `false` | `ios.infoPlist.ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption` ★ |
| `NSAppTransportSecurity.NSAllowsArbitraryLoads` | `false` | Expo default — all our endpoints are HTTPS |

★ **Why `ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption=false` is correct**: we use only HTTPS
(TLS) and Apple's standard authentication APIs. No custom crypto, no VPN, no
proprietary encryption. This auto-skips the Export Compliance question on
every TestFlight upload.

### Required permission strings (NSUsageDescription)

These must be present in `Info.plist` for any feature that touches a
permission-gated API. After verifying the codebase, ShiftRest needs **only one**:

| Key | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription` | `ShiftRest schedules local reminders for caffeine cutoff, melatonin time, and bed-time so your sleep plan actually fires.` | Local notifications via `expo-notifications` |

**Permissions we DO NOT need** (verified — no API usage):

- ❌ `NSCameraUsageDescription` — no camera
- ❌ `NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` / `NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription` — no photo picker
- ❌ `NSMicrophoneUsageDescription` — no audio recording
- ❌ `NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription` / always — no geolocation
- ❌ `NSCalendarsUsageDescription` — we don't read iOS calendar
- ❌ `NSContactsUsageDescription` — no contacts
- ❌ `NSHealthShareUsageDescription` / `NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription` — HealthKit not integrated yet (description hints at "opt-in" — that's a v1.1 promise; remove from description if not adding by v1.0)
- ❌ `NSMotionUsageDescription` — no CoreMotion
- ❌ `NSFaceIDUsageDescription` — no biometric lock
- ❌ `NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription` — no Bluetooth

### Action item

Add `NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription` to `app.json`:

```jsonc
// add inside ios.infoPlist (alongside ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption)
"NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription": "ShiftRest schedules local reminders for caffeine cutoff, melatonin time, and bed-time so your sleep plan actually fires."
```

## 2 · Encryption / Export Compliance

| Question | Answer | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Does your app implement any encryption algorithms? | **Standard only** (HTTPS/TLS) | answered via `ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption=false` in Info.plist |
| Does it qualify for the exemptions in 740.17(b) of the U.S. EAR? | Yes — only HTTPS/TLS | Apple's exemption category 5D002 |
| Need an encryption upload approval (CCATS)? | No | exemption applies |

✅ **No further action.** Each TestFlight build will skip the question.

## 3 · Capabilities (already enabled on Bundle ID via ASC API)

Confirmed via API on 2026-04-28 (see `aso/journal.md`):

| Capability | Status |
|---|---|
| In-App Purchase | ✅ enabled (default) |
| Push Notifications | ✅ enabled |
| Sign in with Apple (`APPLE_ID_AUTH`) | ✅ enabled (`PRIMARY_APP_CONSENT`) |

For Sign In with Apple to work in production, an **APNs Auth Key** (.p8) must
also be uploaded to ASC for the app's push notification config — but only if
we use server-driven push later. For local notifications only, no APNs key is needed.

## 4 · Build configuration

| Field | Value | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Version | `0.1.0` | `app.json` `expo.version` |
| Build number (iOS) | `1` (auto-increments via `eas.json` production profile) | `app.json` `ios.buildNumber` |
| Min iOS deployment target | `15.1` (Expo SDK 55 default) | auto |
| Bitcode | Disabled (Apple deprecated since Xcode 14) | auto |
| New Architecture | Enabled (default in SDK 55) | auto |
| EAS build profiles | development / preview / production | `eas.json` |
| EAS submit profile | production with `appleTeamId` + `ascAppId` placeholders | `eas.json` (TODO: fill once app created in ASC) |

### Build commands you'll run (from Mac, since EAS needs interactive login)

```bash
# 1. one-time: link project to EAS account
npx eas login
npx eas init                                # writes extra.eas.projectId to app.json

# 2. dev sim build (no Apple cert needed)
npx eas build --platform ios --profile development

# 3. preview/TestFlight build
npx eas build --platform ios --profile preview

# 4. production build for App Store
npx eas build --platform ios --profile production

# 5. submit to ASC
npx eas submit --platform ios --latest
```

seed a working account *before* submission.

- 1 generated plan (active) with sleep window, caffeine cutoff, melatonin time, wind-down
- 1 active transition plan (`night_to_day`, 3 days, 2 of 4 day-1 steps marked done)

## 6 · App Tracking Transparency (ATT)

> Does the app collect IDFA / track users across apps?

**No.** ShiftRest doesn't use IDFA, doesn't ship an analytics SDK that tracks
across apps, and doesn't share data with advertisers (per the privacy policy).
**No `NSUserTrackingUsageDescription` needed.**

App Privacy ASC questionnaire — pre-filled answers:

| Data type | Collected? | Linked to user? | Used for tracking? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Email address | Yes | Yes | No |
| Name | Yes (optional) | Yes | No |
| User ID | Yes (Supabase auth, Apple Sign-In) | Yes | No |
| Health & Fitness — Sleep | Yes (sleep schedule, plan) | Yes | No |
| Health & Fitness — Other (rotation, profession) | Yes | Yes | No |
| Diagnostics — Crash data | Yes (Sentry-style) | No | No |
| Diagnostics — Performance | Yes | No | No |
| Usage data — Product interaction | Yes (anonymous events) | No | No |

All other categories: **Not collected**.

## 7 · Common reasons Apple Review rejects (preempt list)

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Privacy URL 404s | Deploy `oqapps/site/` to Vercel before submit |
| Demo account doesn't work | Seed account 24h before submit, manually verify login |
| In-app purchase products not "Ready to Submit" | Create both subs in ASC IAP section, fill metadata, mark ready |
| Subscription terms missing in description | ✅ already present (Pricing block + cancel-anytime line) |
| Medical claims | ✅ NOT-A-MEDICAL-DEVICE disclaimer in description; tone reframed as "planning" not "treatment" |
| Crisis info missing for mental-health-adjacent | ✅ 988 / 116 123 / 13 11 14 in description |
| Permission string omitted for used API | Add `NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription` (see §1) |
| App functions only on a paid tier | ✅ free baseline functions without payment |
| Sign in with Apple not offered when other social login is | ✅ Apple Sign-In is the *primary* path |
| Account deletion missing | ✅ in-app "Delete account" wired (Settings → Account) |
| Trial price/duration unclear | ✅ "7-day free trial" + Monthly $5.99 / Annual $49.99 in description |
| Splash screen broken on cold start | ⚠️ verify after icon-v2 ships (task E #2) |

## 8 · Pre-build smoke test (run on Mac before any `eas build`)

```bash
cd ~/Desktop/work/APP_DEVELOPMENT/shiftrest

# 1. Doctor (currently 17/18 — only patch versions are off, non-blocker)
npx expo-doctor

# 2. Type-check (must be clean)
npx tsc --noEmit

# 3. Local prebuild dry-run (catches Info.plist generation issues early)
npx expo prebuild --no-install --clean
# inspect ios/ShiftRest/Info.plist — confirm NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription present
# revert: rm -rf ios android  (these are .gitignored)

# 4. Manual Metro launch — make sure app starts cleanly
npx expo start --clear
```

If any of those fail, fix before pushing build.

---

## 9 · Submission day flow

1. **Verify** smoke test passes (§8)
2. **Confirm** all checklist items in `docs/app-store-listing.md` §10
3. **Run** `eas build --platform ios --profile production`
4. **Wait** ~20-40 min for build to complete
5. **Run** `eas submit --platform ios --latest`
6. **Open** ASC, version 1.0.0 → "Build" section → select uploaded build
7. **Verify** all metadata from `docs/app-store-listing.md` is filled
8. **Tap** "Submit for Review"
9. **Apple review SLA**: typically 24–48h for first submission
10. **If rejected**: read rejection note, fix, increment build number, re-submit
